**A modified update won't root this car. Neither will its shell command.**

Rasmus Moorats only wanted to fix the clock on his 2014 Renault.

**Two bugs that looked harmless got him root together.**

Three plans, per his write-up.

**Which would you try first? Save this.**
bullets: Patch the update image: a signature check blocked it.
Use the script's shell command: one token, noexec mounts.
Works: a log bug set core_pattern, a crash ran his script.
